text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the prohibition of eastbound left-turns and westbound right-turns from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and from 3:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, September 1 to June 30, from Belsize Drive to Cheston Road. This will address traffic congestion on Cheston Road during the arrival and dismissal times of Maurice Cody Public School.

North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited eastbound left-turns and westbound right-turns from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and from 3:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, September 1 of one year to June 30 of the next following year, inclusive, on Belsize Drive at Cheston Road.
